title: Telemetry-led fallback actuation and circuit plays for regional & tier routing
creator: Aisha Kaur
description: Problem: We currently rely on basic 429/timeouts-based fallbacks that are triggered by per-route simple thresholds. During regional surges and mixed tier traffic the coarse triggers lead to noisy flips and customer-visible variability. Goal: implement a telemetry-driven fallback actuation layer that synthesizes multiple signals (429 rate, timeout rate, p95/p99 latency, queue depth, GPU-util, model-specific error signatures) to decide graduated circuit plays: soft-degrade, divert-to-compatible-variant, and open circuit. The system must be tenant-aware, region-aware, and respect tiering policies so Premium customers avoid premature degradations. This ticket covers design, a proto implementation, tests, and rollout plan for the actuation engine and operators for the circuit state machine.
acceptance_criteria: Decision engine consumes at least five telemetry signals and outputs one of: keep-closed, soft-degrade, variant-fallback, open-circuit, probation-half-open
Fallback activation precision >= 85% on labelled surge test corpus (low false positive fallbacks)
Circuit open duration governed by decay window and tenant probation; system can auto-recover to half-open and then to closed after successful probes
Graceful KV cache handling when diverting to compatible model variants (cache hit-rate drop documented and minimal for prefix-preserving variants)
End-to-end canary in staging exhibits no >3% increase in 5xx for top 10 customers during rollout
Monitoring dashboards with per-region/per-tier signals and playbook links are available in Console rollout view
tasks: Design signal fusion algorithm and scoring heuristic (telemetry weights, smoothing windows)
Implement circuit state machine with explicit states and timers: CLOSED, SOFT_DEGRADE, VARIANT_FALLBACK, OPEN, HALF_OPEN
Integrate decision engine into router hot path with budgeted evaluation latency
Add tenant-tier overrides and policy config (min triggers for Premium tier)
Implement backoff scheduler to avoid oscillation and include exponential decay + jitter
Ensure compatibility-layer fallback handlers preserve request metadata and attempt KV-preserving variants
Create unit + integration tests including synthetic surge harness & chaos injection
Create dashboards, alerts, and a runbook with escalation steps
implementation_notes: Signal set: 429_rate (window 60s), timeout_rate (window 60s), p95_latency (5m), p99_latency (5m), queue_length (instant), GPU_util_90 (1m), model_error_signature_rate (30m)
Score calculation: weighted linear combination with exponential moving average; threshold bands map to plays (soft-degrade at score>0.55, variant-fallback>0.7, open>0.85)
Hysteresis: require sustained breach for 2 consecutive windows before hard play; soft-degrade can be single-window tolerant
Tenant probation: when circuit opens for a tenant, mark tenant as probationed with decaying trip-score; probation period configurable per-tier
Variant selection: prefer variants flagged as 'compatible' in model catalog; fallback uses highest-quality compatible variant under latency budget
KV cache: if variant preserves architecture and tokenizer, attempt in-place cache reuse; otherwise avoid cold-cache surge by rate-limiting fallbacks
Telemetry enrichment: include request-route, tenant_id, model_variant, region, and queue_shard in emitted signals for debugging
testing_plan: Unit tests for scoring and state transitions with synthetic signals
Integration test in staging stress cluster: replay production traces with injected 429 spikes and verify plays
Chaos tests: simulate controller restarts and network partitions to validate safe defaults (favor closed->soft-degrade instead of silent open)
Canary rollout to 5% of traffic in one region, monitor per-tenant SLOs for 48h
Acceptance smoke test with top 10 customers to validate no regression in 99th latency
rollout_plan: Merge feature flag behind 'telemetry_fallback_v2' and default off
Deploy decision engine to staging; run full test harness
Enable for non-production tenants and run for 24h with only alerting (no actuation)
Enable soft-degrade actuation for low-volume production tenants (1% traffic) in us-east-1
Progressively increase to 20% and enable variant-fallback after validation
Enable tenant-tier exemptions for Premium customers during initial ramp
Full enablement with monitoring and rollback playbook after 2 successful weekly windows

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: false-positive fallbacks affecting low-latency SLAs. Mitigation: conservative thresholds for Premium tenants and initial soft-degrade only path
Risk: oscillation between regions or variants. Mitigation: global backoff scheduler with per-tenant cooldown and jitter
Risk: telemetry noise causing incorrect scoring. Mitigation: smoothing windows and minimum sample counts before scoring
Risk: cache thrash when switching variants. Mitigation: prefer compatible variants and rate-limit transitions
